name: street1983nk/pii_redaction
description: PII Redaction: the PHP app with the file action, the review page and the permission checks; talks to the ExApp backend
_comment: phpunit/phpunit is pinned to an exact version: the suite runs inside the autoload space of nextcloud/server (tests/bootstrap.php), and nextcloud/server carries phpunit/phpunit ^11.5 on stable34, the branch the phpunit job of .github/workflows/php.yml checks out. 11 is also the highest major that runs on php 8.2 (12 needs 8.3).

require-dev only and installed in CI only; neither it nor a vendor directory reaches the release archive. The owner cleared the package before it was fetched (plan 01-01, source sebastianbergmann/phpunit).
No composer.lock in the repository yet: the development machine has no PHP, so php.yml resolves the lock in CI and audits it there.
